title: India’s Malhotra Says BRICS Eyeing Faster Cross-Border Payments
summary: India is working to make cross-border payments easier and cheaper while promoting local-currency settlement with its trading partners, Reserve Bank of India Governor Sanjay Malhotra said.

title: Uniper Plans to Sell Properties to Data Center Operators
summary: Michael Lewis, CEO of German energy company Uniper, says the firm has identified more than 10 sites that could be sold or leased for use as data centers, with at least two in Germany and one in the UK. He speaks on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Uniper Targets Data Center Sales in UK, Germany on AI Demand
summary: Uniper SE has identified more than 10 sites across Europe that could be sold or leased for data-center development, as the German utility looks to capitalize on surging demand for AI infrastructure.

title: Intel Raises $20 Billion in Upsized Share Sale for AI Plans
summary: Intel Corp. raised $20 billion in an upsized share sale, a third more than it was targeting when it announced the deal Monday morning.

title: Five Takeaways From Zuckerberg's 6,500-word Manifesto on AI
summary:
Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg touted his views on artificial intelligence in a 6,500-word essay published Monday, emphasizing his belief that wider access to AI models is key to the industry’s future. Riley Griffin has the five key takeaways. 
(Corrects spelling of reporter's name.) (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Horizons Middle East & Africa 8/11/2026
summary: Horizons Middle East & Africa is your daily spotlight on one of the world's fastest-growing regions. Live from Dubai, we bring you the latest global markets and analysis, plus news-making interviews, with a special focus on MEA. All that and more, as you head to the office in the Gulf, pause for lunch in Hong Kong, or start your day in London or Johannesburg.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Apple's iPhone Manufacturing Adds to Growing India Supply Chain: Live Q&A
summary: How Apple’s massive manufacturing expansion in India is reshaping the future of global technology supply chains, on Wednesday, August 12, 2026 at 10:30am HKT, 8am IST.

title: Visma First-Half Annualized Revenue Rises 19% as Customer Base Surges
summary: Norwegian business software provider Visma reported adjusted revenue growing by almost a fifth in the first half, helped by a jump in its customer base.

title: Nvidia Taps Wall Street for $500 Billion Funding Commitment
summary: US investment giants including Apollo Global Management Inc., Blackstone Inc., BlackRock Inc. and Brookfield Asset Management are partnering with Nvidia Corp. to source $500 billion in financing for artificial intelligence infrastructure.

title: India’s Banking Regulator Urges Lenders to Accelerate AI Spend
summary: Indian lenders need to accelerate adoption of artificial intelligence by investing in technology and infrastructure besides training workers to upskill, central bank Governor Sanjay Malhotra said Tuesday.

title: Making Sense of the Multibillion-Dollar Numbers of Nvidia Deal, Intel Share Sale
summary: Nvidia is becoming the "banker of choice to the AI ecosystem" as it seals $500 billion commitments from Wall Street giants. Meanwhile, Intel is looking at its first share sale since the 1970s. Bloomberg's reporters and market watchers make sense of the multibillion-dollar figures, with one noting the capital raise could be a "double-edged" sword for Nvidia. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Titan CFO on Expansion Plans, Gold Demand
summary: Titan CFO, Ashok Sonthalia, says the company is planning to add 35 flagship Tanishq stores over the next one to two years. Speaking with Paul Allen on Insight with Haslinda Amin, he also discussed demand trends, the impact of India's higher gold import duty, and margin outlook. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: VinSpace Signs Launch Pact With SpaceX for 2027 Mission
summary: VinSpace Joint Stock Co., a unit of Vingroup, signed an agreement with SpaceX to launch its first satellites next year, as it seeks to build a domestic space business spanning satellite manufacturing, operations and data services.

title: Amkor Is Said to Mull Stake Sale in $1.5 Billion China Unit
summary: Amkor Technology Inc., a provider of outsourced semiconductor assembly and testing services, is considering options including selling a stake in its China business, according to people with knowledge of the matter.

title: Unitree’s Shanghai IPO 5,526 Times Subscribed by Retail Buyers
summary: The highly anticipated initial public offering of Unitree Robotics drew huge demand from retail investors as China’s leading humanoid robot maker opened books for an offering that’s set to give it a market valuation of $9 billion.

title: China Rocket Explodes During Communications Satellite Launch
summary: A workhorse Chinese rocket blew up while launching a communications satellite, state media reported, the second failure of the rocket family this year.

title: Apple’s Glass-Centric 20th-Anniversary iPhone Remains on Track for 2027
summary: Apple Inc. is still planning to offer a glass-centric overhaul of the iPhone for the device’s 20th anniversary, people familiar with the matter said, countering an analyst report that the move had been canceled.

title: Webtoon Buys $100 Million Game Studio Stake to Expand Reach
summary: Webtoon Entertainment Inc. is buying a majority stake in a Korean gaming studio for about $100 million, in its latest push to expand a content portfolio that includes web comics, anime and gaming.

title: Kioxia Says Investment Vehicle for SK Hynix Is Top Shareholder
summary: Kioxia Holdings Corp.’s biggest shareholder is an investment vehicle that holds shares claimed by rival SK Hynix Inc.

title: Anthropic Strikes $9 Billion Cloud Deal With Riot Platforms
summary: Anthropic PBC has struck a $9.1 billion deal with Riot Platforms Inc., a Bitcoin mining company that recently began selling AI data center capacity, people familiar with the matter said, underscoring the Claude maker’s efforts to secure enough computing power to meet its customers’ demand.
